text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. Another task is object detection, which finds and locates multiple objects in an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in daily life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to recognize pedestrians, traffic signs, and other vehicles. It also helps doctors examine medical images and lets phones unlock with a face. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more common.
